meta.scope: Frontend/quran-dashboard-ui/src handwritten code; generated client at src/app/core/api/generated is models-only
meta.method: static analysis: OpenAPI spec paths matched to handwritten HttpClient call URL templates; wrapper call sites grepped across src/app (non-spec), e2e/, testing/, scripts/; model field names grepped across handwritten .ts/.html
meta.exclusions: node_modules, dist, .git, bin, obj, playwright-report, test-results, *.spec.ts (counted separately as test-only)
meta.confidence_legend: CONFIRMED = code-derived with cited lines; LIKELY = strong static signal with a known blind spot; NEEDS_MEASUREMENT = requires runtime observation; UNKNOWN = cannot classify statically

generated_client_reality.finding: There are NO generated service classes in the repo. npm run generate:api runs ng-openapi-gen then scripts/prune-generated-api.mjs, which deletes everything under src/app/core/api/generated except models/ and models.ts. All HTTP access is via 18 handwritten *.api.ts services.
generated_client_reality.consequence_for_task: Item 1 of this inventory therefore enumerates OpenAPI endpoints and the handwritten wrapper methods that own them, instead of generated service methods.

endpoint_totals.note: 84 endpoints have a handwritten HTTP call expression, but one of them (GET /api/words/word-types/words via WordTypesApi.getRows) is only reachable from spec files, leaving 83 production-reachable endpoints; GET /api/mushaf/surahs has no frontend call at all.

method_notes: Field usage = word-boundary grep of the property name across all handwritten .ts/.html under src/app (specs excluded). A hit anywhere counts as USED because feature view-models commonly re-declare DTO field names as data flows through mappers; this deliberately over-counts USED rather than under-counting.

UNUSED_CANDIDATE (zero text matches) is LIKELY-strength per field despite the CONFIRMED-strength zero-match fact: TypeScript structural typing lets a field travel through object spreads without ever being named, though it can only be RENDERED by being named. Spot-checks (AccessAuditEventItem.beforeState/afterState vs access-audit-log.component.html which renders only actionType/occurredAtUtc/permissionCode/reason) support the classification.

Generic names (id, name, title, code, count, ... full stoplist in audit scratch scripts) and names <= 3 chars are tagged UNKNOWN_CONSUMER, never guessed. Names matched in > 30 files are also demoted to UNKNOWN_CONSUMER.

ApiResponse<T> wrappers (fields data/isSuccess/message/errors) and PagedResult wrappers (items/page/pageSize/totalCount/hasNextPage) and enum/union type aliases are excluded from field analysis: their fields are envelope plumbing consumed by core/data-access and shared pagination code.

duplicate_calls_same_endpoint_per_load.finding: None found statically. Words + mushaf reads all route through ApiResponseCache.getOrLoad which also dedupes in-flight requests (inFlight map), so double-subscription cannot double-fetch. Abwab uses ETag conditional GETs instead of a cache. Access-admin has no cache but its 4 load calls are 4 distinct endpoints.
duplicate_calls_same_endpoint_per_load.caveat: Static analysis only; a runtime network trace (Playwright) would be needed to certify zero duplicates across effect re-runs. Not run (read-only audit).

sequential_without_need.finding: None found. Detail summary + active-view pairs load as independent parallel subscriptions; access-admin uses Promise.all; the only sequential chains are write->revalidate (correctness-required).

core_mechanism.behavior: Map-backed cache of successful ApiResponse payloads. getOrLoad: cache hit -> synchronous replay; miss -> loader with in-flight dedupe (inFlight map, api-response-cache.ts:22) and success-only store (:29). LRU-by-recency eviction capped at DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES=48 (:5, :66). peek() and prefetch() (:41, :51) support optimistic reads and background warming. No TTL, no clear() API - entries live for the session unless evicted.

prune_mechanism.why: Header comment states the locked decision: the project consumes payload DTO interfaces exclusively; generated services are never imported. Pruning keeps the check-api-contract gate deterministic (prune-generated-api.mjs:1-4).

call_sites are production (non-spec) TypeScript only; spec/e2e/testing/scripts matches are counted in test_only_call_sites. e2e specs mock at the route level and reference no additional endpoints beyond the wrappers.

AbwabApi/AbwabTemplatesApi call_sites intentionally include the same-named facade/controller chain (component -> sections/relations controller -> write controller -> api). The terminal this.api.* call is always the one inside abwab-write.controller.ts or abwab-templates.controller.ts.

Endpoint matching: handwritten URL templates were normalized (template params -> {p}) and matched against openapi/swagger.json paths; 84 of 84 handwritten HTTP call expressions matched an OpenAPI path (0 unmatched, 0 out-of-spec calls).

The 7 payload models never referenced in handwritten code (models.totals) are generated-but-dead from the frontend perspective: MushafSurahCatalogResponse (unused endpoint), AccessOwnerReconciliationSummary + OwnerReconciliationStatusCandidate (only parent OwnerReconciliationStatus fields actually read), SegmentFeaturesDto (RenderedSegmentDto.segmentFeatures never consumed), WordMorphologyLemma/Root/Stem (word analysis reads sibling fields via WordMorphologyDto but never names these nested types).

UNKNOWN_CONSUMER field counts are honest generic-name limits, not suspicion of deadness: id/name/title-class names cannot be attributed statically without a type-aware analyzer (LSP find-references per field would resolve them; not run in this pass).
